senses.gloss: (Ezra IV, 8, a. e.) pr. n. m. Shimshai, a scribe of the Samaritan colony; (in legend) a scribe at the court of Ahasuerus. Targ. II Esth. VI, 1.—
units: <cite ref="Megillah 15b:3">Meg. 15ᵇ</cite> sq. (ref. to <cite ref="Esther 6:2">Esth. VI, 2</cite>) <he>מלמד שש׳ מוחק וכ׳</he> this intimates that Sh. had erased (the record in favor of Mordecai), and Gabriel wrote it over.

<cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 1045:2">Yalk. Esth. 1045</cite> <he>המן</he> … <he>הוא ש׳ הסופר כלומר ש׳ בנו וכ׳</he> Haman the wicked, that is Sh. the scribe, that is to say, Sh. the son of Haman; Esth. R. introd.; a. e.
